title: Japanese-Style Chicken Tagine with a French Twist
description: A fusion recipe that combines the flavors of Japan and France, featuring chicken cooked in a traditional tagine with a hint of Japanese spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or clay tagine over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned and caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, togarashi, Garam Masala, tagine spice blend, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the chicken with the sauce spooned over the top.
